area: the Voyages map and the UI theme
summary: Garrett decided the colour rule is universal (2026-11-10, LOCKED: every colour comes from the colour set; not an owner's call), so the held-back Voyage map edits are applied: VoyageMapGraphic, VoyageMapSky, VoyageWindowTabs, VoyageCellDraw, VoyageEdgeGraphic, ArkwayVoyageHud and VoyageToyDefinitionSO read their colours through ColorTrace.Retrace (a trial merge with claude/epic-fermat-6c7n2l has no conflicting lines). And Photic's UI is now exactly the authored theme: every colour set carries all 18 UI tokens and the sea's four colours as ui-token ids, Photic's the authored UITheme (selection Jade as D3 decided) and Sea_Window's own colours; ColorSetUITheme.Build reads them; make_themes.py and author_editor_themes.py give Photic the authored Deep Sea (its soft text 3.6:1 and danger 4.4:1 on a panel, as authored).
why: Garrett, 2026-11-10: 'this is not anyone elses call. this is a fundamental that should be respected universally ... if that rule is broken then it is a sign of incompleteness or a bug'.
